data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old High German word stetan, meaning to stand or establish. The name Steffen is a compound of the Old High German words stet and and, meaning 'crown' and 'garland' or 'wreath' respectively. In medieval Europe, it was a common name for noblemen, as the name symbolized their position and authority. The name Steffen carries the meaning “Crown, garland, wreath” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Steffen usually hope their child will grow to embody crown, garland, wreath and live with faith, good character and purpose.
